verdict.rationale: GitLab's merge-request workflow is referenced indirectly via security findings appearing 'directly in merge requests' and community evidence noting GitHub 'pull requests' being imported into GitLab, confirming the feature exists and is central to its collaboration model. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation describing MR creation, review/approval, and merge mechanics, plus independent hands-on evidence of the end-to-end proposal-discuss-merge flow.
